pairs: to bring (by foot), to fetch (transitive) to transport toward someone/somewhere)
to bear, to bring, to carry
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: принести́ — to bring (by foot), to fetch (transitive) to transport toward someone/somewhere); носи́ть — to carry, to bear (a burden); нести́ — to bear, to bring, to carry; произнести́ — to pronounce, to articulate.
